name: Arcane Stunt
body:
You’ve learned to cast minor magics in order to increase your survivability.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 5 ranks, base attack bonus +5.

Benefit: Choose one of the following spells; expeditious retreat, feather fall, or jump. You gain the ability to cast the chosen spell as a spell-like ability a number of times per day equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum 1) with a caster level equal to your character level.

Special: You may select this feat multiple times, each time you do you either choose a new spell or increase the number of times per day you can use one of these abilities to 2 + your intelligence modifier (minimum 3).
